name: shop-app
title: Shop app screen
description: A generic shopping app on a phone screen, 720x1560 for 9 seconds: the search bar types a query with a blinking caret, four product cards rise in one after another, the first is tapped, its page slides in with name, price, rating and a button, the button is pressed and a toast with a check mark confirms it. Lines: the query, the product's name, its price, the button and the toast. Put it below the phone device frame; it renders in a headless browser.
